notes.title: Steam Release Issues Resolved
notes.notes:
Chronoraptor is up and downloadable on Steam! Mac and Linux versions will come in the coming weeks.

-Studio 73

notes.title: Issues with Steam release.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Chronoraptor was supposed to release today but unfortunately there seems to be some issues getting our game to go live on Steam. We apologize for the delay, we have already contacted Steam support so hopefully the game should be ready to go in the next couple of days. Stay posted, our game will be out soon!

-Studio 73
